party_resources.the_pelican: the Collegium's patched sail-skiff, on loan while you're under charter

notes: Fresh campaign, exploration/magic-forward world. Run session 0 first: create characters (docs/character-schema.md), add their ids to party[], then open in the Chartroom — Magister Voss charters the party to chart the new-risen spire before the tide takes it back. Pacing: reward curiosity over combat; every island should hold one wonder, one hazard, and one question. Wild-magic flavor is encouraged where the Reach runs strong — keep effects strange before dangerous.
